findings.note: Rotowire via CBS (Nov 8, 2026): in the last Spurs–Blazers game, a 125-103 Portland loss on Nov 7, Lillard had only 12 points on 4-8 FG in 20 minutes. That ended his streak of four straight 20-point games. A lopsided game cut his minutes, which favors the Under.

Rotowire via CBS player page: Lillard scored 33 points (10-18 FG, 8-9 FT) in 35 minutes in a Nov 19 win over Milwaukee, which counts against the Under. A blurb dated before that game said he averaged 18.6 PPG in 26.6 MPG on 35.7% FG over his previous five games. No status for this game was found.

NBA.com 2026-27 preview: Lillard is back from 16 months of Achilles rehab. Portland traded for Ja Morant, so it now has four point guards: Lillard, Morant, Henderson and Holiday. That raises questions about shared usage and minutes. In the preseason opener, Lillard and Morant each played 19 minutes.
Smart's last five games (Nov 9–23) show 2, 1, 4, 2 and 3 assists in 17–25 minutes. Only two of those five cleared 2.5, and the Nov 3 note says he moved to the bench.

Smart's only start (Nov 1) came because Fred VanVleet was resting, and he was expected to return to the bench when VanVleet came back. Before that he missed games and was listed as questionable, so the upside depends on VanVleet's status, which I could not confirm for this game.
In the Nov 7 game against Phoenix (Suns won 102-99), the in-game box score showed Smart with 0 assists and 1-of-4 shooting late in the third quarter. This page does not show his final assist total.
